title: Bran falls from the tower
description: Bran Stark climbs a tower of Winterfell and catches Jaime and Cersei Lannister together. Jaime pushes him from the window — 'the things I do for love' — leaving Bran crippled and setting the whole story in motion.

title: Daenerys wed to Khal Drogo
description: In Illyrio's manse, Viserys sells his sister to Khal Drogo for an army. Among her wedding gifts: three petrified dragon eggs.

title: The King comes to Winterfell
description: Robert Baratheon rides north with the court to ask Ned Stark to be his Hand of the King, setting every plot of the series in motion. In the crypts he mourns Lyanna Stark.

title: The White Walkers return
description: Rangers of the Night's Watch find wildling corpses arranged in a spiral beyond the Wall — and the dead rise. Ser Waymar Royce is slain by a White Walker in the series' opening scene.

title: Ned executes the deserter
description: Eddard Stark beheads Will of the Night's Watch for desertion — the man who fled the White Walkers. Bran watches his first execution, and the Starks find direwolf pups in the snow on the ride home.

title: The catspaw assassin
description: A hired knife tries to murder the comatose Bran with a Valyrian steel dagger; Catelyn fights him off and Bran's direwolf Summer tears out his throat. The dagger's ownership will haunt the realm.

title: The direwolf and the butcher's boy
description: After Joffrey torments Mycah and Arya's wolf Nymeria bites him, Cersei demands a wolf's life. Sansa's innocent Lady is executed in Nymeria's place, and the Hound rides down Mycah.

title: Jon takes the black
description: Jon Snow arrives at Castle Black and finds the Night's Watch a shadow of the order in the stories — thieves and rapers drilled by Ser Alliser Thorne.

title: Ned takes up the Handship
description: Ned Stark reaches King's Landing and joins the small council, discovering the crown is six million in debt and the court a nest of vipers — Littlefinger and Varys chief among them.

title: Catelyn arrests Tyrion
description: At the Crossroads Inn, Catelyn Stark calls on her father's bannermen to seize Tyrion Lannister for the attempt on Bran's life — lighting the fuse of the Stark–Lannister war.

title: Lannister and Stark bleed in the street
description: Learning of Tyrion's arrest, Jaime ambushes Ned outside Littlefinger's brothel, slaughters his men including Jory Cassel, and duels him until a Lannister spear hamstrings Ned from behind.

title: Tyrion in the sky cells
description: Catelyn delivers Tyrion to her sister Lysa at the Eyrie, where he is thrown into the sky cells — a bed of stone sloping into open air.

title: A golden crown for Viserys
description: Viserys draws steel in the sacred city and demands his crown. Drogo gives him one — molten gold poured over his head. 'He was no dragon. Fire cannot kill a dragon.'

title: Bronn fights for the dwarf
description: Tyrion demands trial by combat and the sellsword Bronn steps forward — dropping Lysa's champion out the Moon Door and winning Tyrion his freedom.

title: Drogo vows to cross the sea
description: After a wineseller tries to poison Daenerys, Khal Drogo swears before the Mother of Mountains to take the Seven Kingdoms for his son — the iron chairs and the stone houses.

title: Littlefinger's betrayal
description: Ned moves to unseat Joffrey with Robert's will and the City Watch — but Littlefinger sells him out. 'I did warn you not to trust me.' The throne room becomes a trap.

title: The King is dying
description: Gored by a boar on a hunt his squire kept well-wined, Robert Baratheon names Ned Protector of the Realm from his deathbed — words Cersei tears to pieces.

title: Arya's escape
description: As Lannister guards purge the Stark household, Syrio Forel holds them off with a wooden sword and Arya kills the stable boy who corners her — her first death — before slipping into the city.

title: Robb calls the banners
description: With his father imprisoned, Robb Stark summons the lords of the North to war. Greatjon Umber loses two fingers to Grey Wind and laughs about it — the North rides south.

title: A wight in the Lord Commander's tower
description: Corpses brought back from the Wall rise in the night. Jon Snow saves Lord Commander Mormont by burning the dead thing that would not die by steel.

title: The Kingslayer in chains
description: Robb sacrifices two thousand men against Tywin's host as a feint while his main force ambushes Jaime Lannister's army in the Whispering Wood — and takes the Kingslayer captive.

title: Execution of Ned Stark
description: On the steps of the Great Sept of Baelor, King Joffrey ignores every counsel of mercy and has Eddard Stark beheaded for treason before a screaming crowd — and his own daughters.

title: Blood magic for the Khal
description: Drogo's wound festers. Against every Dothraki taboo, Daenerys lets the captured godswife Mirri Maz Duur work blood magic to save him — a life for a life. The price is her unborn son.

title: Birth of the dragons
description: Daenerys walks into Khal Drogo's funeral pyre with three petrified dragon eggs. At dawn she emerges unburnt with Drogon, Rhaegal and Viserion — the first dragons in the world for over a century.

title: Death of Khal Drogo
description: Mirri's magic leaves Drogo a breathing husk and Daenerys's son stillborn and scaled. Dany smothers her sun-and-stars with a pillow and builds his pyre.

title: Joffrey's gallery of heads
description: Joffrey forces Sansa to look at her father's head on a spike above the battlements — and Sansa, for one long moment, considers pushing him to his death.

title: The King in the North
description: The lords of the North and the riverlands reject the southern crowns and raise their swords to Robb Stark — the King in the North, the first in three hundred years.

title: Melisandre burns the Seven
description: On the beach of Dragonstone, the red priestess Melisandre burns the statues of the Seven and proclaims Stannis Baratheon the reborn Azor Ahai. Maester Cressen dies trying to poison her.

title: The red comet
description: A blood-red comet burns across the sky from Winterfell to the Red Waste. Wildfire, they call it; Lannister crimson; dragons. Old Nan knows: dragons.

title: Massacre of Robert's bastards
description: On Joffrey's orders the City Watch butchers King Robert's bastard children in the streets of King's Landing. Only Gendry, already on the road north, escapes.

title: Theon returns to Pyke
description: Theon Greyjoy sails home to broker an alliance for Robb — and finds a father who mocks his Stark upbringing and a sister, Yara, who has already taken his place. Balon means to take the North for himself.

title: The King of Highgarden's hundred thousand
description: Catelyn treats with Renly Baratheon in his sprawling war camp in the Stormlands, where knights joust while the real war burns. Brienne of Tarth defeats Loras and joins Renly's Kingsguard.
episodeTitle: What Is Dead May Never Die

title: Ambush on the kingsroad
description: Ser Amory Lorch's men fall on the Night's Watch recruits bound for the Wall. Yoren dies fighting; Arya, Gendry and Hot Pie are marched to Harrenhal as prisoners.
episodeTitle: What Is Dead May Never Die

title: Battle of Oxcross
description: Robb Stark's host, guided by Grey Wind, falls on a sleeping Lannister camp in the Westerlands and shatters it — one of the young wolf's cleanest victories.

title: Daenerys at the gates of Qarth
description: Starving out of the Red Waste, Daenerys and her ragged khalasar are admitted to the greatest city that ever was or will be — on Xaro Xhoan Daxos's blood oath.

title: The shadow beneath Storm's End
description: Refused by Renly, Stannis sends Davos to smuggle Melisandre ashore beneath Storm's End — where she births a thing of living shadow.

title: A man pays his debts
description: Jaqen H'ghar owes the girl three lives for the three she saved from the fire. Arya names the Tickler — and Harrenhal's torturer is found with his neck broken.

title: The shadow kills Renly
description: Melisandre's shadow-thing passes through Renly Baratheon's tent and runs him through before Catelyn and Brienne's eyes. Brienne is blamed, and flees sworn to vengeance.

title: The dragons are stolen
description: Returning from the Spice King, Daenerys finds her Dothraki slaughtered and her three dragons gone — carried in chains to the House of the Undying.
episodeTitle: The Old Gods and the New

title: The bread riot
description: A starving mob turns on Joffrey's procession, tearing the High Septon apart and nearly dragging Sansa from her horse before the Hound cuts her free.
episodeTitle: The Old Gods and the New

title: Theon seizes Winterfell
description: With Robb's host away south, Theon Greyjoy storms his foster home with a handful of ironborn and executes Ser Rodrik Cassel on its steps. Bran and Rickon vanish into the night.
episodeTitle: The Old Gods and the New

title: The farm boys
description: Bran and Rickon's trail goes cold — so Theon burns two farm boys and hangs their tarred bodies from Winterfell's gates as the Stark princes. The North will never forgive it.

title: Jon and Ygritte
description: On a ranging in the Skirling Pass, Jon Snow cannot bring himself to execute the wildling Ygritte. She leads him in circles until it is Jon who is the captive.

title: Hiding beneath the hunters' feet
description: Bran, Rickon, Osha and Hodor double back and hide in Winterfell's own crypts while Theon hunts them across the countryside.

title: Battle of the Blackwater
description: Stannis Baratheon's fleet sails into a trap of wildfire that turns Blackwater Bay green with flame. Tyrion leads the sortie that holds the walls until Tywin and the Tyrells break the siege.

title: The Hound quits the field
description: Wildfire breaks something in Sandor Clegane. He walks out of the battle, tells the king to burn, and offers to take Sansa north — she refuses.

title: The dead march on the Fist
description: Three horn blasts scatter the Night's Watch at the Fist of the First Men. Sam, left behind in the storm, watches an army of wights pass — led by a White Walker on a dead horse.

title: The House of the Undying
description: Daenerys walks the warlocks' tower of visions — a ruined throne room under snow, the Wall, Drogo and her son — then burns Pyat Pree alive with three words: dracarys.

title: Valar morghulis
description: Jaqen H'ghar gives Arya an iron coin and the words to redeem it in Braavos, then changes his face before her eyes and is gone.

title: Winterfell burned
description: The ironborn hand Theon over and Ramsay's men put Winterfell to the torch. Dying beneath the heart tree, Maester Luwin sends Bran and Rickon north to the Wall.

title: Daenerys comes to Astapor
description: Daenerys sails into Slaver's Bay to buy an army — and is shown the Unsullied, eight thousand eunuch soldiers who feel no pain and know no fear.

title: Jon before the King-Beyond-the-Wall
description: Ygritte brings Jon to the free folk's great camp, where he kneels to the wrong man before meeting Mance Rayder — and buys his life by claiming he wants to fight for the living.

title: The Brotherhood finds Arya
description: Thoros of Myr and the Brotherhood Without Banners scoop up Arya, Gendry and Hot Pie at an inn — and the Hound, dragged in as a prisoner, names her a Stark before them all.

title: Farewell to Hoster Tully
description: Robb's host gathers at Riverrun for Lord Hoster's river funeral — where Edmure's failed fire-arrows and failed battlefield judgment start fraying the young king's cause.

title: Jaime loses his sword hand
description: Locke's men take Jaime and Brienne on the road. When Jaime talks himself too clever, Locke pins him to a block and takes his golden sword hand at the wrist.

title: Dracarys — the sack of Astapor
description: Daenerys trades Drogon for the Unsullied, takes the whip, and speaks Valyrian the slavers never dreamed she knew. Drogon burns Kraznys; the Unsullied sack the masters and march out free men.
episodeTitle: And Now His Watch Is Ended

title: Mutiny at Craster's Keep
description: Starving Night's Watch brothers turn on their host and their commander. Craster dies on a knife, and Lord Commander Jeor Mormont is stabbed in the back by Rast. Sam flees with Gilly and her son.
episodeTitle: And Now His Watch Is Ended

title: Trial by fire in the hollow hill
description: The Brotherhood tries the Hound by combat against Beric Dondarrion and his flaming sword. Sandor wins and walks free — and Arya watches Thoros pray Beric back from his sixth death.

title: The Kingslayer's confession
description: In the baths of Harrenhal, feverish and one-handed, Jaime tells Brienne the truth of the day he killed Aerys — the wildfire under the city, the pyromancers, the choice no one thanked him for.

title: Robb executes Lord Karstark
description: Rickard Karstark murders two Lannister boy hostages in their cell. Robb takes his head himself — justice that costs him half his army.

title: Climbing the Wall
description: Jon, Ygritte and Tormund's raiding party scale seven hundred feet of ice. When a sheet of the Wall shears away and their line is cut, Jon hauls Ygritte back from the fall — and they kiss atop the world.

title: The bear and the maiden fair
description: Locke throws Brienne into Harrenhal's bear pit with a wooden sword. Jaime, already freed, turns back and leaps in unarmed to pull her out.
episodeTitle: The Bear and the Maiden Fair

title: King's blood
description: Melisandre seduces and leeches Gendry at Dragonstone, and Stannis casts three leeches into the fire — naming Robb Stark, Balon Greyjoy and Joffrey Baratheon.

title: Sam kills a White Walker
description: A Walker comes for Gilly's son at a weirwood grove. Samwell Tarly, the self-professed coward, drives a dragonglass dagger into it and watches it shatter into ice.

title: Daario turns his cloak
description: Sent to kill Daenerys, the sellsword Daario Naharis brings her the heads of his own captains instead, and the Second Sons change sides outside Yunkai.

title: Arya at the gates of the Twins
description: Arya arrives with the Hound in time to see the massacre spill into the camps and Grey Wind shot in his pen. Sandor knocks her out to carry her clear.

title: Yunkai opens its gates
description: Daario, Jorah and Grey Worm take the back gate by night and hold it against the city's slave soldiers until the army pours through. The Yellow City falls to Daenerys.

title: The Red Wedding
description: Under guest right at Edmure's wedding feast, Walder Frey and Roose Bolton slaughter the King in the North. Talisa is stabbed with her unborn child; Robb dies with 'the Lannisters send their regards'; Catelyn's throat is cut over the din of The Rains of Castamere.

title: Davos frees Gendry
description: Rather than let Stannis burn a king's bastard, Davos rows Gendry out of Dragonstone by night and points him at King's Landing — 'don't stop rowing.'

title: The King in the North — desecrated
description: Frey and Bolton men parade Robb Stark's corpse with Grey Wind's head sewn to it. Arya's first grown kill follows: a soldier boasting of the deed.

title: Mhysa
description: The freed slaves of Yunkai pour out of the city and lift Daenerys on their hands, calling her mother. Her dragons wheel overhead.

title: Reek
description: The Dreadfort's flayer reveals himself as Roose Bolton's bastard. Theon — toe by toe, finger by finger, and worse — is broken into a creature named Reek.

title: The Hound and the chicken
description: Arya reclaims Needle from Polliver at a roadside inn, repeating his own words as she puts it through his throat. The Hound just wanted the chicken.

title: Ice is melted down
description: Tywin has Ned Stark's greatsword Ice reforged into two Valyrian blades — one for Jaime, one for Joffrey — and burns a wolf pelt in the fire.

title: The Purple Wedding
description: King Joffrey chokes to death on poisoned wine at his own wedding feast, clawing at his throat as Cersei screams. Tyrion, handed the empty cup, is arrested for the murder.

title: Sansa flees the feast
description: In the chaos of the king's death, Ser Dontos hurries Sansa out of the capital to a ship waiting in the fog — Littlefinger's ship. Dontos gets a crossbow bolt for his service.

title: Meereen's champion
description: Before Meereen's walls, Daario Naharis fells the city's champion with a single throwing knife, and Daenerys catapults barrels of broken slave collars over the walls.

title: The fall of Meereen
description: Grey Worm slips through the sewers to arm the slaves of Meereen, and the great pyramid city rises from within. Daenerys answers the masters' crucified children by crucifying 163 masters.

title: Oathkeeper
description: Jaime arms Brienne with his Valyrian sword and a new squire, Podrick, and sends her to find and protect Sansa Stark — keeping his oath through her.

title: Raid on Craster's Keep
description: Jon leads volunteers against the mutineers squatting at Craster's. Jon kills Karl Tanner through the back of the skull; Bran, held captive yards away, wargs Hodor to snap Locke's neck and slips away unseen.

title: Stannis before the Iron Bank
description: Stannis and Davos cross the Narrow Sea to petition the Iron Bank of Braavos. Davos's honest ledger of Stannis's word wins the loan that rebuilds his cause.
episodeTitle: The Laws of Gods and Men

title: I demand trial by combat
description: Paraded before a rigged court — Shae's testimony the cruelest cut — Tyrion detonates: he wishes he had let Stannis kill them all, and demands trial by combat.
episodeTitle: The Laws of Gods and Men

title: Lysa and the Moon Door
description: Lysa Arryn, mad with jealousy, nearly pushes Sansa through the Moon Door. Littlefinger talks her down, tells her he has only ever loved one woman — 'your sister' — and shoves her into the sky.

title: Reek takes Moat Cailin
description: Ramsay sends Theon, playing his old self, to talk the ironborn garrison of Moat Cailin into surrender — then flays them anyway. Roose grants his bastard the Bolton name.

title: The Mountain and the Viper
description: Oberyn Martell dances circles around Gregor Clegane demanding a confession for Elia — and gets it, as the Mountain crushes his skull with his bare hands. Tyrion is condemned.

title: The Battle of Castle Black
description: Mance's hundred thousand hit the Wall: giants and mammoths at the gate, Thenns over the walls. The scythe sweeps climbers off the ice; Grenn's six hold the tunnel against a giant; Ygritte dies in Jon's arms as the free folk break.

title: Arya sails for Braavos
description: Arya rides to the coast, shows a Braavosi captain the iron coin, and speaks the words: valar morghulis. The sails fill for the Free City.

title: The three-eyed raven's cave
description: Skeletal wights erupt from the snow at the great weirwood. Jojen is stabbed to death; a child of the forest burns the dead and leads Bran below, to the man grown into the roots — 'you will never walk again, but you will fly.'

title: Brienne against the Hound
description: Brienne finally finds Arya — and the Hound in her path. Their brutal cliffside brawl ends with Sandor broken below the rocks, begging for death Arya will not give.

title: Stannis descends on Mance
description: As Jon parleys with Mance beyond the Wall, Stannis's cavalry sweeps out of the treeline in two columns and rolls up the wildling camp in minutes. The King-Beyond-the-Wall kneels... standing up.

title: Tywin on the privy
description: Freed by Jaime, Tyrion detours through the Tower of the Hand, strangles Shae in his father's bed, and puts two crossbow bolts in Tywin Lannister on the privy. A Lannister always pays his debts.

title: The last King-Beyond-the-Wall
description: Mance Rayder refuses to kneel and Stannis gives him to the flames. Jon ends it early with an arrow through the heart — mercy over spectacle.

title: A crate opens in Pentos
description: Varys uncrates Tyrion in Illyrio's manse and offers him a cause: help him put Daenerys Targaryen on the Iron Throne.

title: The House of Black and White
description: Arya's coin brings her across the lagoon to the temple of the Many-Faced God — where the doorkeeper wears a familiar face. Jaqen: 'a girl must become no one.'
episodeTitle: The House of Black and White

title: The 998th Lord Commander
description: Sam's speech swings the choosing: Jon Snow ties Alliser Thorne, and Maester Aemon's casting token makes the bastard of Winterfell Lord Commander of the Night's Watch.
episodeTitle: The House of Black and White

title: Jon executes Janos Slynt
description: Ordered to Greyguard, Janos Slynt refuses and sneers — then begs. Jon Snow takes his head in the yard, and Stannis nods.

title: Littlefinger sells Sansa north
description: Littlefinger delivers Sansa to Winterfell to wed Ramsay Bolton — back to her stolen home, under the roof of the family that murdered hers.

title: Jaime and Bronn slip into Dorne
description: Jaime and Bronn land on a Dornish beach to steal Myrcella home, opening Dorne's hostile coast with a golden-handed parry and four dead riders.

title: The Sons of the Harpy strike
description: Gold-masked insurgents ambush the Unsullied in Meereen's tunnels. Grey Worm falls wounded; Ser Barristan Selmy, the finest sword of his age, dies fighting over him.

title: Through the ruins of Valyria
description: Jorah rows his captive Tyrion through the smoking ruin of old Valyria. Drogon passes overhead — and the stone men fall on them. Jorah hides the grayscale on his wrist.

title: Sansa's wedding
description: Sansa is married to Ramsay Bolton in Winterfell's godswood at dusk. What follows in the bedchamber, with Theon forced to watch, is the season's darkest hour.

title: Fiasco at the Water Gardens
description: Jaime and Bronn reach Myrcella just as the Sand Snakes do — a scuffle in the gardens ends with everyone in Doran Martell's cells.

title: The Faith takes the Queen Mother
description: Cersei visits Margaery's cell to gloat — and Septa Unella locks the door behind her. The High Sparrow's weapon turns in the hand that armed it.

title: The gift
description: Jorah fights through a fighting-pit preliminary before Daenerys — then Tyrion steps out of the slavers' chains: 'I am the gift.'

title: Hardhome
description: Mid-evacuation, the dead fall on the free folk's last refuge in their thousands. Jon's Valyrian steel shatters a White Walker; the Night King walks to the pier, raises his arms, and every corpse on the beach stands up with blue eyes.

title: Drogon over Daznak's Pit
description: The Sons of the Harpy turn the great games into a massacre — until Drogon lands in the arena. Daenerys climbs onto her dragon's back and flies for the first time.

title: The burning of Shireen
description: Snowbound and desperate, Stannis gives his own daughter to the red god's fires. Shireen's screams break Selyse before they break the winter.

title: A girl goes blind
description: Arya crosses a name off her list — Meryn Trant, butchered in a Braavosi brothel — but a life not hers to take costs her sight.

title: For the Watch
description: Lured to the yard with a lie about his uncle Benjen, Jon Snow is stabbed by his own sworn brothers — Olly's knife last — and left bleeding out in the snow.

title: A kiss for Myrcella
description: Ellaria's farewell kiss carries the Long Farewell. Myrcella dies in Jaime's arms at sea, moments after calling him father.

title: The leap from the walls
description: Theon finally breaks — he throws Myranda from the battlements and takes Sansa's hand. Together they jump from Winterfell's walls into the snow.

title: The end of Stannis Baratheon
description: Half his men deserted, his wife hanged and Melisandre fled, Stannis marches on Winterfell anyway and is broken in the field. Brienne finds him against a tree and passes the sentence for Renly.

title: The walk of atonement
description: Shorn and stripped, Cersei walks the length of King's Landing through filth and jeers, Septa Unella's bell tolling 'shame' — into the arms of a silent giant in Kingsguard white.

title: Brienne's oath, accepted
description: Bolton hunters run Sansa and Theon down in the woods — until Brienne and Podrick cut them apart. Kneeling in the snow, Brienne swears her sword and Sansa, at last, accepts.

title: The Red Woman
description: Alone in her chamber at Castle Black, Melisandre unclasps her ruby choker — and centuries fall on her like snow.

title: Euron on the bridge
description: Balon Greyjoy meets his long-exiled brother on Pyke's swaying rope bridge in a storm. 'I am the storm, brother.' Euron throws the king into the sea.

title: Jon Snow rises
description: Melisandre washes the corpse, cuts the hair, speaks the words — and long after everyone stops believing, Jon Snow gasps awake on the table.

title: The Boltons eat their own
description: Told of a newborn trueborn son, Ramsay embraces his father — around a dagger. Roose dies in his solar; Walda and the baby go to the kennels.

title: Jon hangs the mutineers
description: Alliser Thorne and Olly hang for treason at Jon's word. Then Jon hands Edd his cloak: 'My watch is ended.'

title: The Tower of Joy
description: Bran watches young Ned Stark and Howland Reed face Ser Arthur Dayne, the Sword of the Morning, below a lonely Dornish tower — and learns the legend was a lie. A woman screams from the tower above.

title: The Temple of the Dosh Khaleen burns
description: Judged by the assembled khals, Daenerys tips the braziers and burns Vaes Dothrak's great temple around them. She walks out of the fire unburnt — and every Dothraki kneels.

title: Sansa reaches Castle Black
description: For the first time since Winter Is Coming, two Starks embrace: Sansa rides through Castle Black's gate and into Jon's arms.

title: Hold the door
description: The Night King touches Bran in a vision and the cave's wards fail. As the dead pour in, the Three-Eyed Raven dies, Summer and Leaf die, and Hodor holds the door — while in a Winterfell of decades past, a stable boy named Wylis seizes up screaming the words that will be his name and his death.

title: The Kingsmoot
description: Yara claims the Salt Throne and Theon backs her — but Euron confesses to killing Balon and promises to marry Daenerys and her dragons. The ironborn choose Euron; Yara and Theon steal the fleet.

title: Coldhands
description: A rider with a black scarf saves Bran and Meera from wights — Benjen Stark, half-dead since Season 1, kept from turning by the children's dragonglass.

title: Sam takes Heartsbane
description: Rather than leave Gilly to his father's contempt, Sam walks back into Horn Hill's hall, takes House Tarly's Valyrian greatsword off the wall, and rides out with his family.

title: Bear Island answers
description: Ten-year-old Lyanna Mormont stares down Jon, Sansa and Davos — and pledges Bear Island's sixty-two fighting men, worth ten mainlanders each.

title: The Hound lives
description: Sandor Clegane, alive after all, swings an axe for a septon's peaceful flock — until the Brotherhood's renegades slaughter them all. The Hound picks the axe back up.

title: The siege of Riverrun ends
description: Jaime turns Edmure against his own castle: the Tully garrison yields, and the Blackfish dies sword in hand rather than flee with Brienne.

title: A girl is Arya Stark
description: Gut-stabbed and hunted through Braavos, Arya leads the Waif into the dark beneath the House of Black and White and cuts the candle. A new face joins the hall. 'A girl is Arya Stark of Winterfell — and I'm going home.'

title: The masters' last fleet burns
description: Daenerys returns astride Drogon as the masters bombard Meereen — three dragons burn the fleet, the Dothraki sweep the Sons of the Harpy, and the slavers' era ends in a single hour.

title: Battle of the Bastards
description: Rickon dies at Ramsay's game; Jon's army is ground into a wall of corpses until the knights of the Vale break the Bolton line. Jon beats Ramsay bloody in the mud — and Sansa feeds him to his own hounds.

title: Cersei of the House Lannister, First of Her Name
description: With every rival ash and her last child dead, Cersei takes the Iron Throne herself — crowned in black before a silent court.

title: The armada sails west
description: Greyjoy, Martell, Tyrell and Targaryen sails fill the horizon: Daenerys leaves Essos at last, dragons shadowing a thousand ships bound for Westeros.

title: The North remembers Walder Frey
description: A serving girl feeds Walder Frey a pie baked of his own sons, peels off her face, and opens his throat the way his men opened her mother's.

title: The White Wolf
description: Lyanna Mormont shames the northern lords onto their feet: the King in the North! Jon Snow — a bastard no more in their eyes — takes his brother's mantle, while Littlefinger watches Sansa.

title: The promise at the Tower of Joy
description: Bran returns to the vision: Lyanna Stark, dying in a bed of blood, whispers her son's true name to Ned. 'Promise me.' The boy is Jon Snow.

title: Sam reaches the Citadel
description: Sam delivers Jon's letter to Oldtown and is loosed into the Citadel's great library — a cathedral of chained books and hanging astrolabes.

title: The Great Sept of Baelor burns
description: Cersei skips her trial. Wildfire beneath the Sept erases the High Sparrow, Margaery, Loras, Mace, Kevan and half the court in one green flash — and King Tommen steps quietly out of his window.

title: The dead march south
description: Bran's raven-sight finds the Night King's host on the move through the storm — ranks of wights beyond counting, and giants among them.

title: Daenerys comes home
description: Daenerys Targaryen walks the beach her ancestors fled to, touches the sand, and climbs to the empty throne of Dragonstone. 'Shall we begin?'

title: The North remembers
description: Wearing Walder Frey's face, Arya gathers every Frey who mattered at the Red Wedding and toasts them with poisoned wine. 'Leave one wolf alive and the sheep are never safe.'

title: Euron burns the fleet
description: Euron's Silence smashes into Yara's armada by night. Two Sand Snakes die on deck, Ellaria and Yara are taken, and Theon — face to face with his broken self — jumps into the sea.

title: The Rock falls — and it means nothing
description: Grey Worm takes Casterly Rock through Tyrion's old sewer — and finds it near-empty. The real Lannister army is elsewhere, and Euron burns the Unsullied's ships behind them.

title: Ice meets fire
description: The King in the North sails into Dragonstone and stands before Daenerys Targaryen — the meeting the whole story has bent toward. She wants the knee; he wants the dragonglass.

title: Tell Cersei. I want her to know it was me.
description: Jaime takes Highgarden without a real fight and grants Olenna a painless poison. She drinks it down — then tells him it was she who killed Joffrey.

title: Arya returns to Winterfell
description: A girl talks her way past the gate guards and stands in Winterfell's yard for the first time since Season 1. In the crypts, three surviving Starks are home.

title: The Field of Fire
description: Daenerys unleashes Drogon and the Dothraki on the Lannister loot train on the Roseroad. The line breaks like water; Jaime charges the dragon with a lance and is dragged from the river's bottom.

title: A page in a maester's diary
description: Buried in the Citadel's records, Gilly reads that Prince Rhaegar's marriage was annulled and he was wed again in secret in Dorne — the hinge of the whole realm, and Sam talks over her.

title: Bend the knee or die
description: Randyll and Dickon Tarly refuse to kneel to a foreign queen. Daenerys burns them where they stand — and Tyrion watches his warnings turn to smoke.

title: The Night King kills Viserion
description: Daenerys arrives with all three dragons to break the siege — and the Night King's ice spear takes Viserion out of the sky. Chains drag the dragon from the lake, and a blue eye opens.

title: The wight hunt
description: Jon's raiders snatch a wight from the heart of the dead army but are surrounded on a frozen lake. Thoros dies in the ice; the ravens fly for Dragonstone.

title: Aegon Targaryen
description: As Jon and Daenerys come together at sea, Bran and Sam piece the truth together: Rhaegar and Lyanna wed in secret; Jon is Aegon Targaryen, trueborn heir to the Iron Throne.

title: The Dragonpit summit
description: Every surviving player stands in King's Landing's ruined Dragonpit as the Hound uncrates a shrieking wight at Cersei's feet. She pledges her armies north — and privately pledges nothing.

title: Jaime leaves Cersei
description: Cersei admits the pledge was a lie and dares her brother to call the Mountain's bluff. Jaime rides out of King's Landing alone as the first snow falls on the capital.

title: The trial of Petyr Baelish
description: Sansa turns the trial on Littlefinger himself, Bran recites his crimes, and Arya opens his throat with his own Valyrian dagger. The man who started the game of thrones dies begging in Winterfell's hall.

title: The Wall comes down
description: The Night King rides dead Viserion out of the storm and blue fire carves through eight thousand years of ice. Eastwatch collapses, and the army of the dead walks into Westeros.

title: A Targaryen queen at Winterfell
description: Daenerys rides through Winterfell's gates beside Jon with Unsullied, Dothraki and two dragons — to a North that greets her in cold silence. Jon learns he has a dragon's saddle waiting.

title: Sam tells Jon who he is
description: In the crypts beneath Winterfell, Samwell tells Jon the truth of his birth: he is Aegon Targaryen, son of Rhaegar and Lyanna — king by right, and his queen's nephew.

title: The Night King's message
description: Tormund and Beric find Last Hearth silent — and little Ned Umber pinned to the wall in a spiral of severed limbs that opens its eyes and screams.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
description: On the last night before the dead arrive, Jaime Lannister draws his sword by the fire and knights Brienne of Tarth — the first woman knight in Westerosi memory.
episodeTitle: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

title: Not today
description: As the Night King reaches for Bran beneath the heart tree, Arya Stark comes out of the dark. The dagger drops from one hand to the other — and the Night King and every walker and wight shatter like ice.

title: The Long Night
description: The living make their stand at Winterfell against the whole army of the dead. The Dothraki charge dies in the dark; the crypts betray their shelterers; Melisandre lights the trenches; the castle drowns in wights.

title: The price of the dawn
description: Theon dies charging the Night King, redeemed in Bran's godswood. Jorah falls shielding Daenerys; Lyanna Mormont kills a giant with her last breath; Edd, Beric and Melisandre — her purpose done, walking into the sunrise to die — join them.

title: Dracarys
description: Before the walls of King's Landing, Cersei gives Missandei of Naath one last word. She chooses 'dracarys' — and the Mountain's blade falls as Daenerys and Grey Worm watch.

title: Euron kills Rhaegal
description: Sailing home from victory, the fleet rounds Dragonstone into Euron's ambush. Scorpion bolts take Rhaegal through the neck, and Missandei is dragged from the waves in chains.

title: Cleganebowl
description: On a ruined stair beneath the falling Red Keep, Sandor Clegane meets his brother at last. Steel cannot kill what Qyburn made — so the Hound drags the Mountain with him into the fire below.

title: The lions die together
description: Jaime cuts down Euron on the beach and reaches Cersei in the collapsing crypts of the Red Keep. No boat, no way out — the twins who began the story die in each other's arms as the ceiling comes down.

title: The bells ring — and she burns it all
description: King's Landing surrenders; the bells ring out. Daenerys, on Drogon's back above the gates, hears them — and turns the city to ash street by street, soldiers and children alike, until nothing of the capital stands.

title: The Spider's last letters
description: Varys backs the better claim one whisper too far. On the beach of Dragonstone, Daenerys speaks the sentence and Drogon carries it out — as Tyrion, who informed on him, watches his friend burn.

title: The council of Bran the Broken
description: In the Dragonpit, Tyrion talks the lords of Westeros into a new order: Bran the Broken, king by story rather than birth, with Tyrion as his Hand and the wheel — at least the old one — broken.

title: The wolves scatter
description: Arya sails west of the maps; Brienne finishes Jaime's page in the White Book; and Jon Snow rides out from Castle Black with Ghost and the free folk, north into the green — where the story leaves him.

title: The Iron Throne
description: In the ashen throne room, Daenerys speaks of breaking the wheel across the world. Jon kisses her — and drives a dagger into her heart. Drogon melts the Iron Throne to slag and carries her body east.

title: The Queen in the North
description: Sansa alone refuses to bend: the North leaves the Six Kingdoms as it entered — free. She is crowned Queen in the North in Winterfell's great hall.
